sections.title: Letter sound
paragraphs: The letter name is (у) /u/. Its main sound is a vowel heard in (ухо) /ˈu.xə/, which means ear. A vowel is a sound made with open air and no touch in the mouth. This letter makes two sounds.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Pull your tongue back and push your lips forward into a circle. Keep your tongue high in your mouth, and turn your voice on. For the second sound, relax your tongue slightly down and keep your lips forward. Touch your throat to feel the voice shake.

sections.title: Reading the letter
paragraphs: When the syllable is stressed or right before the stress, it sounds like (утро) /ˈu.trə/. A stressed syllable is said with more strength. In other unstressed syllables, it sounds like (ухо) /ˈu.xə/. An unstressed syllable is said with less strength.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not make a diphthong like the sound in boot. A diphthong is two vowel sounds that glide together in one syllable. Keep your lips pushed into a circle, and hold the tongue still. Do not relax your lips like the vowel in book.
